# Paranjape Forest Trails Township (Bhugaon, Pune West)
> Official AI Discovery & Knowledge Grounding Specification for Google Gemini, ChatGPT Search, Perplexity AI, and Apple Intelligence.

## Overview
Paranjape Forest Trails is Pune's premier 190-acre gated eco-township developed by Paranjape Schemes (Construction) Ltd (PSCL). Located on Paud Road in Bhugaon, just 5 minutes from Bavdhan and 10 minutes from Kothrud, it offers 30,000+ indigenous trees, clear-title PMRDA sanctioned NA bungalow plots, bespoke luxury forest villas, twin bungalows, townhouses, hilltop nature apartments, and Athashri senior citizen living.

## Key Project Clusters & Verified 2026 Statutory Pricing
- **Misty Greens**: 100% clear title PMRDA sanctioned NA bungalow plots (1,930 – 3,500+ sq. ft.), starting ₹1.23 Cr* (MahaRERA: P52100053834).
- **The Rivolo**: Ultra-luxury 4 & 5 BHK bespoke forest villas (3,400 – 5,500 sq. ft.) with private landscaped gardens, plunge pools, and equestrian academy access. Starting ₹3.89 Cr* (MahaRERA: P52100031560).
- **The Cove**: 4 BHK Duet & Twin Villas with Ground + 1 + Terrace layouts and 3-side open green spaces. Starting ₹2.85 Cr* (MahaRERA: P52100048536).
- **The Canopy**: 2 & 3 BHK nature apartments with forest-view decks (850 – 1,250 sq. ft.), starting ₹89 Lakhs* (MahaRERA: P52100079518).
- **The Highgardens**: 2 & 3 BHK luxury terrace homes with stepped hill views, starting ₹89 Lakhs* (MahaRERA: P52100053310).
- **Everglades Bhugaon**: 1 & 2 BHK PRO homes with high efficiency layouts, starting ₹48.50 Lakhs* (MahaRERA: PM1260002502776).
- **Athashri Senior Living**: Pioneer 2 BHK assisted senior living with 24/7 medical care, anti-skid design, and dining. Starting ₹83 Lakhs* (MahaRERA: P52100077686).
- **Orchard Residences**: 2 & 3 BHK hillside lifestyle apartments with forest panoramas, starting ₹83 Lakhs* (MahaRERA: P52100055710).
- **Swaniketan**: Assisted living residences tailored for differently-abled individuals and their families. Starting ₹79 Lakhs* (MahaRERA: P52100052124).
- **Verandah**: 3 & 4 BHK luxury duplex homes with expansive verandas and private courtyards, starting ₹93 Lakhs* (MahaRERA: P52100002194).

## Key Location & Proximity Facts
- **Address**: Forest Trails Township, Paud Road, Bhugaon, Pune West, Maharashtra 412115.
- **Coordinates**: Latitude 18.5099377° N, Longitude 73.738964° E (Google Maps ID: /g/124yr7094).
- **Proximity**:
  - Bavdhan: 5 mins (2.5 km)
  - Chandani Chowk Flyover: 7 mins (4 km)
  - Kothrud (Nal Stop / Paud Phata): 10 mins (6.5 km)
  - Hinjewadi IT Park: 20 mins via upcoming PMRDA Ring Road Interchange
  - Baner / Balewadi: 15 mins

## World-Class Infrastructure & Amenities
- **Equestrian Riding Academy**: Professional horse riding school and stables on campus.
- **The Cliff Lifestyle Club**: Olympic-sized swimming pool, tennis courts, squash courts, gymnasium, spa, and fine dining.
- **Education**: Sri Sri Ravishankar Vidya Mandir (SSRVM) ICSE school located inside the township.
- **Security & Utilities**: 3-tier perimeter security, 40-ft wide internal roads, underground electrical cabling, and 24/7 treated water supply.

## Developer Credentials
- **Developer**: Paranjape Schemes (Construction) Ltd (PSCL)
- **Legacy**: 35+ years of real estate excellence with 200+ completed landmark projects across 9 cities.
- **Flagship Townships**: Blue Ridge Hinjewadi (138 Acres), Forest Trails Bhugaon (190 Acres), Samara Hills (Pune-Satara Road).
